title: Enumerative Combinatorics of Homogeneous Linear Orderings
summary: We count the number of countable homogeneous colored linear orderings in $k$ colors. Relatedly, we count the number of countable $C_{n,m}$-homogeneous linear orderings. $C_{n,m}$-homogeneity is a strong homogeneity notion that approximates $sp-$homogeneity, a notion recently uncovered in [2] to have important computability theoretic properties. Explicit formulas are derived for both of the quantities in question, along with asymptotic bounds.
